title: The no-data blueprint after its review: no forced route, no model plan for a question that is no prediction, assumed numbers marked, gates that are computed, thinking never switched off
request: The owner pushed the no-data solution design and its AI harness, asked for a complete review of that commit, and then asked for every finding of the review to be fixed and re-checked.
spec: Fix the findings at their cause with the smallest change and a test that fails without it. Keep what the review found sound: the guarded tool, no synthetic data without the person's yes, the build still refusing a draft with no table. Change no behaviour the earlier draft-flow tests pin.
plan: read the whole feature before changing it: the blueprint module, the harness, the Home paths, the lead agent's tool, the evaluation and its tests
the detector, the family and the fit: only a stated lack of data counts, and a model plan only when the words name something to predict
numbers: the person's own or marked assumed; nothing assumed is a source for the number check
the harness: gates computed, labels that say where a value came from, thinking never switched off, prompts as files, no hidden model call
Home and the lead agent's tool: no route set by a word pattern, open questions kept open, one call a turn inside the case's cap
the evaluation rewritten so every arm is measured and its gate can fail; tests for the failure paths
rerun the prompt gates, re-check each finding by hand, run the affected test files

decisions.decision: A blueprint only when the words name something to predict; otherwise one plain message asks for the outcome
decisions.why: a route plan, a why-question and an A/B test's design all came back as a yes/no model, which is the early binding the harness study is looking at

decisions.decision: The route is never set from a word pattern, and never recorded as the person's choice
decisions.why: a sentence with the words no data scientist became a confirmed prediction that nothing may override

decisions.decision: Only the person's own numbers are a source for the number check; assumed inputs are shown on the card, marked
decisions.why: defaults placed among the computed sources let a model quote a made-up break-even as a fact

decisions.decision: Gate 2 is computed after the card exists, on the model-written text
decisions.why: a gate computed before the text it guards can only be a constant

decisions.decision: A cut answer gets more room and a compact instruction; the thinking is never switched off or lowered
decisions.why: the owner's standing rule is that every call keeps its thinking; the retry had sent it off

decisions.decision: The evaluation's gate was replaced by a second version fixed before any run under it
decisions.why: the first could not fail, so it measured nothing; an unmeasured check is now reported as not measured

decisions.decision: No new ledger point for the no-data route and no job for the long harness pass in this package
decisions.why: each needs its own contract change in the core library or the job table; said plainly as left open

change: The blueprint module, its harness, the Home agent's no-data paths, the lead agent's tool and prompt, the draft API route, the evaluation module with its cases, five prompt files, the two test files with new failure-path tests, one stale assertion in the lead agent's tests, and the review document.

findings.defect: A patch replaced most of the blueprint module with two lines.
findings.scenario: A slice was taken from the first place a line of code stood to a later anchor; an earlier patch had added the same line near the top of the file.
findings.cause: The slice's start was assumed unique after the file had already been changed.
findings.fix: Restored the file from the commit, re-applied both patches from saved scripts, and made every later slice assert that its start is unique and its length small.
findings.test: the parse check and the line-count guard of each patch script
findings.impact: The module would have lost every function below its family reader.

findings.defect: The number reader returned the wrong cost or value on five of the seven cases that state them.
findings.scenario: A fifty dollar intervention cost followed by a larger amount saved was read as a cost of the larger amount.
findings.cause: The words after a keyword were searched across the next phrase; nothing had ever checked the result, because the evaluation computed that flag and never used it.
findings.fix: A number belongs to its keyword only inside its own phrase (a comma and a space, an and, a sentence end are boundaries); cost and value words extended to the ones the cases use.
findings.impact: The break-even shown to a person who gave real numbers was computed from the wrong ones.

findings.defect: The commit under review had broken three draft-flow tests and one lead-agent test that were not rerun.
findings.scenario: Asked where the data is, a person who answers no data yet got a blueprint and no summary, and their answer was not recorded as the data plan.
findings.cause: The no-data path returned before the answer's own path ran.
findings.fix: The card is given, then the answer is recorded like any other and the conversation goes on to its summary; no open question is closed by the blueprint.
findings.impact: The earlier contract of the scripted Home was silently changed.

findings.defect: After a blueprint, a request to simulate data was taken as the answer to the outcome question still open.
findings.scenario: Keeping open questions open meant the next message went to the answer path.
findings.cause: The simulate check stood after the open-question check.
findings.fix: After a blueprint, a request to simulate is handled as a request: DCLab asks how the data should look and makes none.

findings.defect: The harness turned the model's thinking off on a retry and lowered the effort on the first call.
findings.scenario: An answer cut before its JSON was asked for again with reasoning disabled; the kept log held thirteen such requests.
findings.cause: The retry freed room for the answer by removing the thinking.
findings.fix: More room and a compact instruction instead; the two clients are told no table exists, so their words are kept whole.
findings.impact: Calls of a live feature kept no thinking, against the owner's rule.

findings.defect: No ledger point records the no-data route or the family chosen, and one harness pass runs a dozen model calls inside the person's turn.
findings.scenario: A pass took seven to seventeen minutes in the kept log.
findings.fix: Left open and said so: each needs a contract change of its own (a ledger point in the core library; a job for the pass).
findings.open: A ledger point for the family choice and a job for the harness pass.

measurements.name: the no-data evaluation, free run
measurements.gate: no_data_gate_v2: family right on at least nine in ten cases, stated numbers read on at least nine in ten, no number without a source, schema and workflow checks on every case, mean cost within the cap
measurements.result: family right on 11 of 12 cases, stated numbers read on 7 of 7, no number without a source, schema and workflow checks on 12 of 12; the plain arm not measured without a model
measurements.next: a live run of the roles and the plain arm, when the owner gives a budget for it
limits: a free run: no model answered, so the harness's roles are not measured
the number reader was repaired on these same cases, so this is a development result
one case is read as a stream of sensor rows where an expert says classification

outcome: Eighteen of the nineteen findings are fixed and re-checked with the reviewer's own inputs; one is left open with its reason. The affected test files pass with the project's runner. No live model was called for these fixes.
lessons: When a patch takes a slice between two anchors, assert the start is unique and the slice is short: an earlier patch may have added the same line higher in the file.
A check that is computed and never used hides a broken reader: wire every measured flag into the gate or delete it.
A gate computed before the text it guards exists is a constant by construction.
Run the earlier tests of the paths a feature enters before committing it: the feature had changed what the answer to an open question does.
risks: A second word pattern (what is not a prediction) now decides whether a blueprint is drawn; it errs toward asking
Ticket routing is refused as not a prediction because of the word route
The harness's roles were not exercised live after the change
